### Root Cause
When calculating the data range for an axis in [`XYPlot.getDataRange`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/chart_4_group_c_fix/source/org/jfree/chart/plot/XYPlot.java#L4425), if a dataset had no associated renderer (`r == null`), the method attempted to call `r.getAnnotations()` unconditionally, throwing a `NullPointerException`.

### Fix
Added a null check `if (r != null)` before accessing annotations from the renderer in [`XYPlot.java`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/chart_4_group_c_fix/source/org/jfree/chart/plot/XYPlot.java#L4493).
